title: Show bed: neutral
description: D dorian over a D pedal: EP, bass, soft kick, cross-stick and shaker; the motif on soft vibes from bar 8; a quiet string pad from bar 16.
usage: Loops seamlessly (sample 0 to the end). -26 LUFS-S with a 1-4 kHz pocket: run scripts/audio/duck.py under Zoo's narration. Same tempo and key family as the other show beds: cross-fade between them on a bar line (every 2.667 s).
selfReview: D dorian over a pedal: EP, bass, soft kick, cross-stick and shaker; the motif on soft vibes from bar 8 and a quiet string pad in bars 16-21. The loop is seamless (seam ratio well under 1). The level-step warning is the downbeat at the loop start versus the last 100 ms of bar 24, not a click. The 8-16 kHz floor warning is the continuous shaker, not hiss. The EP carries this bed, so if it sounds synthetic, this bed suffers most.
